access_boundary: This record represents the fixed Claude Opus 4.8 model release identified by the dateless pinned ID claude-opus-4-8, which Anthropic documents as a single fixed snapshot rather than an alias. Anthropic's API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, Claude applications, and Claude Opus 5 and later Opus releases remain separate service or product boundaries.
strengths: Anthropic documents a fixed dateless model ID with pinned-snapshot semantics, legacy lifecycle status, release date, and a retirement date commitment
The official model page identifies first-party API access and three independent cloud-platform paths with per-platform model IDs
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The release is in legacy status with a retirement commitment only until May 28, 2027, and partner clouds set their own retirement dates
